headline: 5 Ways to Get a French Cottage Garden Look
items: Plant lavender and roses together
Use gravel paths with soft edges
Add a weathered stone bench
Let climbers cover an old wall
Keep colours soft: blush, lilac, cream

headline: Cottage Garden Borders That Look Full All Year
items: Plant tall flowers at the back
Layer mid-height perennials
Edge the front with low herbs
Repeat 3 plants for a calm look
Add bulbs for early spring colour

headline: Small Cottage Garden Ideas for Tiny Yards
items: Grow up: arches, trellis and fences
Use pots to fill bare corners
Pick one path and keep it narrow
Mix flowers with herbs and veg
Choose a colour theme of 3 shades

headline: Get the Cottage Garden Aesthetic in 5 Steps
items: Start with a winding path
Plant in loose, overlapping groups
Add roses, foxgloves and delphiniums
Use old pots, crates and watering cans
Leave a little wild on purpose

headline: What a Good Garden Planner Should Include
items: A scaled map of your beds
Sun and shade notes for each spot
A planting calendar by month
A plant list with spacing
A notes page for what worked

headline: Winter Garden Ideas That Still Look Beautiful
items: Add evergreen shrubs for structure
Leave seed heads for birds and frost
Plant hellebores for late winter flowers
Use lanterns and warm lights
Order seeds and plan beds now

headline: Plan Your Vegetable Garden Before Spring
items: Measure your beds and sunny spots
Rotate crops: never repeat a bed
Group plants that grow well together
List sowing dates for your frost date
Leave room for paths and watering
